description: How many views a clip needs before a campaign pays it, and what the clip earns at a given number of views, after the campaign's floor and the marketplace fee. The floor comes from the campaign's minimum payout and minimum views. The pay is views times the rate per 1,000, nothing under the floor, never over the cap, then the fee: Content Rewards keeps 10 percent of CPM payouts, and a campaign hosted on heistclips leaves that fee off the clipper. Answers 'how many views do I need to get paid', 'what will this clip earn', 'I get 500 views, does this pay', 'a new account cannot earn'. views_per_clip is the user's views (a new account is about 500). campaign is an id, slug, title or URL; without one, the campaigns those views already clear and the views the others still need.

account_size.description: When they do not give a number: new = about 500 views a clip (default); 5k = about 5,000; 50k = about 50,000

campaign.description: One campaign: id, slug, title or URL. Leave out for every live campaign at this size.

limit.description: How many campaigns in each list when no campaign is named (default 8)

views_per_clip.description: The user's views per clip. Overrides account_size.

name: clip_earnings_estimate
title: Views a clip needs before it gets paid, and what it earns
